chunks: 3256 - And ʿAlī عليه السلام gave judgment regarding a woman who came to him and said: “Indeed, my husband had intercourse with my bondwoman without my permission.” So he said to the man, “What do you say?” He said, “I did not have intercourse with her except with her permission.” Then ʿAlī عليه السلام said, “If you are truthful, we will stone him; and if you are lying, we will administer the prescribed punishment to you.”

And the salat was established, so ʿAlī عليه السلام stood praying. Then the woman reflected within herself, and she saw no relief for herself either in the stoning of her husband or in her receiving the prescribed punishment, so she left and did not return.
And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام did not ask about her afterward.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.قَضَى: gave judgment or issued a legal ruling

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام judge when a woman accused her husband of relations with her bondwoman?
ai.summary: This hadith records a judicial ruling of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in a dispute involving a husband, wife, and bondwoman, where the legal consequences of each claim were made clear. The woman withdrew her accusation after recognizing the implications of the case, and the Imam عليه السلام did not pursue the matter further.
